formula.ascii: Edges accumulate per community label c: internal L_c (weight of edges with both ends in c), outgoing and incoming volumes d_c (an undirected edge adds its weight to both end communities, so V = sum of volumes = 2W). contribution[c] = factor*L_c/V - resolution*outgoing_c/V*incoming_c/V with factor 2 for undirected and 1 for directed graphs (incoming = outgoing when undirected); Q = sum of contributions via a GPU sum reduction. Invalid labels or weights, or zero total weight, publish zero score and contributions.
